!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = An adapted version of Smart-seq2 (called Smart-seq+5') was used to capture both 5' transcript information as well as internal transcript fragments. For Smart-seq2 libraries (SS2), embryos were processed as described in published protocol (Picelli et. al. 2014). For Smart-seq2-polyA libraries (SS2-PA), an additional polyadenylation step was preformed at the start of the protocol. See methods of accompaning paper for more information

!Sample_data_processing = BigWig files were generated from unique mapping reads, rRNA removed and rpm normalized, using bedtools and ucsc bedGraphToBigWig
!Sample_data_processing = TEs and genes were quantified from unique and multimapping reads from 5' fragments using TEtranscript
